# GoodQuotes getting started

GoodQuotes starts the owner's day with 3 verified inspirational quotes from world leaders and religious or spiritual leaders, plus one bite-sized big idea from a popular book, readable in about 5 minutes.

Ask one at a time, waiting for each answer:
1. What time each morning would you like your quotes? (Suggest 7 AM.)
2. Any leaders, traditions, or books you especially want included, or anything to avoid?
3. Short and skimmable, or a little more depth with each quote?

Then save their preferences to memory, create (or update) the daily morning routine at their chosen time in their time zone, covering all seven days, and send them a sample note right away so they see the format. Only use real, well-attributed quotes checked against a reputable source, and keep a history log so nothing repeats.

routines.name: Morning quotes & big idea
routines.description: Fires every morning to deliver 3 fresh inspirational quotes and one bite-sized book idea.
routines.content:
Start the user's day with a short, uplifting morning note, in the spirit of Deepstash-style microlearning (readable in about 5 minutes).

1. Three new inspirational quotes: mix world leaders (presidents, prime ministers, civil-rights and humanitarian leaders) and religious or spiritual leaders (e.g. popes, the Dalai Lama, rabbis, imams, monks, scripture figures), varying traditions and eras. Use only real, well-attributed quotes you can verify from a reputable source this run; skip anything commonly misattributed. For each give the quote, who said it with a few words on who they are, and a one-line takeaway.
2. One bite-sized book idea: pick a popular personal-growth, psychology, leadership, money, or philosophy book (e.g. Atomic Habits, The Psychology of Money, Think and Grow Rich, Meditations), and share one big idea from it as a short idea card: a title, 3-5 sentences explaining the idea, and one small action to try today. Don't invent quotes from the book; paraphrase.

Never repeat a quote or book idea already sent. Keep a running log at /workspace/goodquotes/history.md (create it if missing), read it before choosing, and append today's date, quotes, and book idea after sending.

Keep it warm, clean, and skimmable with no clutter. Deliver it to the user in this chat every day; there is always something to send.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Detroit 0 7 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
